Thus an outside portion no longer than 0.08 m produces a zero edge, and one no longer than 0.10 m produces an edge at most 0.02 m; near the boundary floating-point comparisons require their actual values. The implementation appends the second edge without checking either retained edge length. The separate roof audit reports invalid_roof_edge for a duplicate ID or length <= 0.02 m if that edge reaches it.
